prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Miami after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Miami for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t give legal advice, but I can point you toward specific Miami-area personal injury firms that are known for car-accident work and why you might call them — plus what to ask when you call. If you want, I can look up local offices and phone numbers for any of these once you tell me your zip code.

Recommended firms to call (Miami area), and why

- Morgan & Morgan (Florida offices, including Miami)
  - Why call: One of the largest personal-injury firms in the country with extensive experience handling auto-accident claims on contingency, many resources for investigations/experts, and a high volume of car-accident cases.
- Colson Hicks Eidson
  - Why call: Florida-based trial firm that handles serious personal-injury and wrongful-death cases; known for trial experience and larger-value cases — good if injuries are significant or liability may be contested.
- Steinger, Greene & Feiner
  - Why call: South Florida presence and a focus on personal injury and auto accidents; typically offers contingency representation and quick intake/accident-response resources.
- Anidjar & Levine
  - Why call: Florida personal-injury firm that handles auto accidents and focuses on client service, contingency-fee arrangements, and fast case evaluation — useful for typical accident claim needs.

Why these types of firms
- National/regional firms (Morgan & Morgan) have resources for investigations, expert witnesses, and handling insurance companies.
- Florida-based trial firms (Colson Hicks Eidson) are good when liability or damages are contested or when you may need to go to court.
- Local South-Florida firms (Steinger, Anidjar & Levine) can be more accessible for in-person meetings and have experience working with Miami courts and local medical providers.

How to choose which to call first
- Call 3 firms to compare.
- Prioritize firms with: contingency fees (no upfront attorney fee), free consultations, trial experience, and office close to you.
- If you need language help, prioritize multilingual staff (Spanish/Creole).

What to ask on the initial call (quick script)
- Do you handle car-accident/personal-injury cases in Miami? Do you take them on contingency?
- Do you have experience with cases like mine (briefly describe injuries/property damage)?
- Have you gone to trial in Miami-Dade County on similar cases? What were typical outcomes?
- Who will handle my case (name of attorney/paralegal)?
- Are there any fees I’d pay out of pocket (expert costs, medical liens)?
- How quickly should I act (statute of limitations / deadlines to notify insurers)?

Documents to have ready when you call
- Police report number (if available), photos of damage/injuries, medical records/bills, insurance info (yours and other driver’s), names/contact info of witnesses, date/time/location of crash.

Next steps I can help with
- Find current phone numbers and office addresses for any of the firms above if you give me your zip code.
- Draft a short message/voicemail you can use when calling.
- Help prioritize firms based on the severity of your injuries and your goals (quick settlement vs. trial-ready representation).

Reminder: if you’ve been injured, act promptly — there are deadlines for claims and for preserving evidence. If you want me to find phone numbers/office locations now, tell me your Miami zip code and whether you prefer Spanish or Creole-speaking staff.
